title: Adding the same kind of thing

ask.text: Write the load.

hints.text: A load standing on one pan. It settles inward-out.
Gather the two of one kind and carry each term's sign with it.
The two like counts come to 3. The rest of the load has not moved.

worldFraming.text: Gather like into one. The load gets shorter; the kind never changes.

ask.text: Name the joint that will not hold, and what it should read.

hints.text: A load standing on one pan. It settles inward-out.
Read down the working. One line does not follow from the one above it.
Line 2 is where the load stops matching.

worldFraming.text: This is the Second Rung, and the crane will not pretend otherwise.

ask.text: Stack a load that gathers to -1*x + 4*y + -7.

hints.text: A load standing on one pan. It settles inward-out.
Build it long. It only has to gather short.
Gathered, it must read -1*x + 4*y + -7. How it gets there is yours.
